We are a veterinary clinic, located in the bay area, that's dedicated to the health and well being of animals. Our goal with this channel is to educate/entertain by showing off all cute and fun moments that come from being in our field and working so closely with animals! If you want to learn more about us, or want to book an appointment, you can visit our website https://oaktreevet.com 

address: 579 San Ramon Valley Blvd, Danville, CA 94526
